body_markdown:
The following features and fixes are available on the[latest](https://docs.unlayer.com/builder/latest/version-management) channel and are candidates for the next stable release:


## Changes


-


**1.471.0:** Added[Brand Context](https://docs.unlayer.com/ai/assistant/customization/brand-guidelines) , allowing the AI Assistant to follow your brand identity, visual style, and tone. Brand Context can be configured at runtime or managed in Console, including importing a public website to create a draft.


-


**1.473.0:** Improved[AI Assistant](https://docs.unlayer.com/ai/assistant) performance, efficiency, and generation reliability, including automatic fallbacks and per-request AI Credit usage details. Also fixed validation failures with legacy designs and improved failure diagnostics.


-


**1.474.0:** Added a live AI Credits balance to the AI Assistant and introduced[in-builder credit upsell](https://docs.unlayer.com/builder/latest/credit-upsell) , allowing you to show host-managed per-user balances and connect your own purchase flow.


-


**1.475.0:** Preserved EXIF image orientation in sent emails, fixed built-in tool icon overrides in classic themes, and kept custom Body and Images tab icons consistent while active.


-


**1.476.0:** Fixed` setToolValidator` overrides being lost and ensured` excludeTools` applies to tools registered after initialization.


-


**1.477.0:** Fixed superscript text spacing in email mode on mobile browsers.


-


**1.482.0:** Upgraded[Inbox Previews](https://docs.unlayer.com/builder/latest/email-builder/inbox-previews) with updated email-client selection, project-level defaults, per-client usage, and clearer access and limit states. Editors using a version before 1.479.0 will automatically migrate to the new Inbox Previews provider on September 7, 2026 at 00:00 UTC, without requiring a version change. You can try the latest version in our[Console](https://console.unlayer.com/) .


-


**1.485.0:** Added an opt-in AI Template Importer to the embedded AI Assistant, turning HTML and images into editable designs.
